cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Sell the Disaster
cards.instruction: Make a terrible plan sound sensible, responsible, and inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I've advanced the charity our estimated auction takings. Now we just need bidders.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You borrowed five thousand. Only your mum registered.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. One bidder keeps catering costs down. That's responsible fundraising.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mum's only coming to give us a lift.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we must bid ourselves. Raise the card limit; protecting that donation has to come first.
